prompt: Attached are two authentic Bilibili character stickers of Xingtong in the SAME outfit: 揣手手 and 老实. The strip of flat paint chips below is sampled from those originals. Treat their shapes and exact original colors as the design model. Clean finished hand-drawn Japanese/Chinese chibi sticker, subtly detailed: thin yet decisive deep charcoal-indigo contour, softly modeled two/three-tone cel shading, crisp selected highlights, a trace of paper tooth. Color as a daylight-painted sticker on white, never a violet or pink color wash, no glow, no type, no diagram or tiles. The silver bob has NEUTRAL cool silver grey local color RGB 197,194,201, broad near-white ribbon-shaped painted reflections, cool grey shadows 160,157,170, very little chroma. Bright clear medium sky-blue irises (74,141,233) and white glints. Distinct softly rounded CORAL dash blush from the original at both cheeks. Skin warm ivory-peach, thin pink mouth. Soft cardigan is pale icy PERIWINKLE RGB 219,220,253, bluer than mauve and distinct from grey hair; pearly ivory fur collar, rose-pink inner top. Headband deep violet, little white round mascot with blue dot and tiny coral cheeks. Preserve the distinctive rounded side hair, large grouped locks and asymmetric crown forelock exactly. The large isolated head is the REVIEWED master design; trace its precise silhouette, headband placement, exact colors, size, hair highlight blocks and iris shape. Produce a registration-locked ANIMATION CONTACT SHEET. Exactly THREE columns and THREE rows of nine equally sized, separated square cells on a single pure white background with invisible divisions. Each cell a single large detached head only, the identical front-facing, upright head and direct level gaze throughout. No hands or body in any cell. The entire bob, chin, headband mascot and forelock completely fit EACH cell with 4% air on all sides. Maintain the same center, proportions, bob length and tiny coral blush dashes in every drawing. No head tilts or spatial offsets in this sheet; the animator will rotate the head later. These are NINE different subtle mouth and cheek animation cels for a moody puffed-cheek head shake: 1) tiny pinched angled mouth, light puff; 2) lips purse a little tighter as cheeks begin to inflate; 3) round cheeks inflate visibly, brows settle; 4) maximum puff, wry narrowed eyes, brief sideways glance; 5) hold swollen cheeks but small mouth shifts toward center, brows relax; 6) smaller counter-puff, slight cheek squish; 7) gently release air through a tiny open O; 8) softer cheeks with tiny O closing, eyes lift a little; 9) settle back to the original tight pout, adjacent to first. Deliberate readable cheek/lip variation. Same authentic neutral silver gray hair, cobalt/sky-blue iris and periwinkle palette. Nine whole finished clean drawings, no cropping, captions, panel lines, gradients or bleed outside each separated square.
